description.en: Open, close, stop and go to a position; the position is read after each command and every 10 s. Frames: 55, address, function, data, CRC-16/Modbus (low byte first). Control commands are answered with the same frame.
description.zh-Hant: 開、關、停、到指定位置；每個指令之後和每 10 秒讀回位置。訊框：55、位址、功能碼、資料、CRC-16/Modbus（低位在前）。控制指令會原樣回送。

description.en: Motor address as sent on the line, ID_L then ID_H. Factory FE FE: give every motor its own address before putting several on one bus (00 00 is broadcast and gets no reply).
description.zh-Hant: 馬達位址，照線上順序 ID_L、ID_H。出廠是 FE FE：同一條匯流排接多台前，要先各自改成不同位址（00 00 是群控，不會回覆）。

notes.en: Position 100 = open, 0 = closed, as in Home Assistant. Until the limits are set (and after a power cut) the motor answers FF to position commands and reads, which is ignored; run a full open or close first. The motor sends nothing by itself, so the position comes from polling.
notes.zh-Hant: 位置 100＝全開、0＝全關，跟 Home Assistant 一樣。行程還沒設定（或斷電後）時，位置指令和讀取都回 FF，會被忽略；請先跑一次全開或全關。馬達不會主動回報，位置靠輪詢。
